evidence.text: The exact File page identifies 肉-seal.svg as a vector depiction of 肉 in Shuowen seal-script style. It points to Sinica Database and Hanziyuan among its source leads, says this drawing follows Hanziyuan image s02971, and records uploads in April and May 2007. Its representation is released to the public domain. It is a modern drawing, not an ancient artifact photograph.

gaps: The Academia Sinica record gives script categories and a pictographic interpretation but no dates for individual specimens or complete graphic sequence.
Commons 肉-seal.svg is a modern vector representation of a Shuowen seal-style form; its page does not identify a photographed source exemplar or date the form it represents.

The exact Commons File:Shuowen Seal Radical 135.svg page could not be accessed in this run, so that candidate's image, provenance, and rights remain unverified. No Unihan or historical pronunciation verification was performed for this review task.

items.period: Modern drawing uploaded 2007; represents the Shuowen Small Seal tradition
items.caption: Modern vector drawing of 肉 in Shuowen seal-script style. The source identifies the script tradition; it does not date the represented form.
items.alt: A single black seal-style 肉 glyph, with a rounded outline and strokes inside.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons page identifies the graph and seal-script style, provides the original SVG, and records public-domain release. It offers a sourced seal-style example without presenting a modern drawing as an ancient artifact.
items.rights: Public domain release of the SVG representation; attribution is not required but appreciated.

limitations.text: This is a modern drawing, not an ancient artifact image. The inspected paleographic record identifies oracle-bone, Chu manuscript, and Small Seal categories, but does not date individual specimens or establish a complete sequence of graphic changes.
